summary.text: Woody Woodsome is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 139, York County, representing Limerick, Parsonsfield, and Waterboro.
The page lists committee service on Environment and Natural Resources and Inland Fisheries and Wildlife.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Woody Woodsome's education as UMO (B.S., 1970).
The page lists Woody Woodsome's occupation as Retired Teacher.
Listed affiliations include Elks, Eagles, Waterboro Historical Society.
Woody Woodsome lives in Waterboro and has served 2 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
The page also lists 2 sessions in the Senate.
Committee assignments listed: Leaves of Absence (ranking member); Environment and Natural Resources (member); Inland Fisheries and Wildlife (member).
Family details on the page: 2 children.
